reviewer: Executing agent; not independent human review
method: Compared all 46 facts with their cited source text in fixtures/factsheet.json; accepted any supplied record for duplicate URLs. The supplied owner metadata, Wikidata descriptions/IDs and reverse-side search snippet support the generated claims.
limitations: Eight Degas facts are bare values (for example a year or artist name) rather than standalone factual sentences. This weakens the next docent step even though their sources are correct.
Several facts repeat the title; no difficult provenance disputes or rich multi-institution research were tested.
All works are from one owner institution; trust scores were assigned by the fixture author.
